notes: Recommendation: install Meson as pure Python. The sdist recipe (unpack into {runtime_dir}, run meson.py with the app's Python or the catalogue's Python) is the default on every OS: vendor sha256 from PyPI, four confirmed China mirrors, no pip, network or compiler needed, and the Python chosen sets the OS floor. If the app is itself a Python app, installing the wheel with its own pip is equivalent. The Windows MSI is a fallback for apps with no Python: self-contained (PyInstaller Python + ninja.exe) but x64-only from 0.54, no vendor checksum, absent for some releases, and its bundled Python sets a Windows 8+ floor from 0.56. The macOS .pkg is not recommended (installs to /usr/local, single-arch, stopped after 1.8.2). {python} is the Python interpreter of a Python runtime installed for this app (the app's own, or the catalogue's Python installed as a build-only runtime): a new token installer-builder must resolve, since Meson is pure Python.

prerequisites: a Python runtime meeting the version's requires_python (3.3 for 0.29-0.41, 3.4 for 0.42-0.44, 3.5 for 0.45-0.56, 3.6 for 0.57-0.61, 3.7 for 0.62-1.11, 3.10 for 1.12+)
recipes.notes: Run 2026-09-18 on Linux: meson-1.12.0.tar.gz unpacked (strip 1) into a folder with a space, run with the system Python 3.12 and with the catalogue's python-build-standalone 3.14.7; setup + install of a hello-world C project with Ninja 1.13.2 worked and HOME stayed empty. meson.py puts its own folder first on sys.path, so no PYTHONPATH is needed and -E is safe. On Windows use backslashes; same command. {python} is the Python interpreter of a Python runtime installed for this app (the app's own, or the catalogue's Python installed as a build-only runtime): a new token installer-builder must resolve, since Meson is pure Python.

project_install.notes: Configures, builds and installs the app's Meson project (installer-builder design.md 1.8). Ninja comes from catalog/ninja via its path_prepend (Meson looks for `ninja` on PATH; a user's NINJA variable is cleared so it can't substitute another). Meson writes nothing outside the build folder and --prefix (checked with an empty fake HOME). Minimum Ninja: 1.5 (Meson 0.40-0.53), 1.7 (0.54-0.56), 1.8.2 (0.57+).

Wheels exist from 0.59.3; older versions use the sdist recipe. recipes.notes: Not run (Linux-only testing). The MSI holds a PyInstaller-frozen meson.exe with its Python DLL, the UCRT DLLs and ninja.exe (seen in the MSI's file table strings), so no Python or Ninja runtime is needed: put {runtime_dir} on PATH so the bundled ninja.exe is found. A normal install is per-machine (and may add itself to PATH, not verified); an administrative install (msiexec /a) runs none of that. The image folder name under TARGETDIR could not be read on Linux, so the copy step tries the likely candidates. x86 MSIs stop at 0.53.1.

Payload layout read from the 0.58.1, 1.1.1 and 1.8.2 packages: usr/local/bin/ninja and the PyInstaller folder usr/local/share/meson-<ver>/ (meson plus its Python).
